Demon space-time data set

Source: R/data.R
demontexas.Rd

Temperature data for space-time models requiring latitude and longitude coordinates. Contains minimum, mean, and maximum temperatures at 369 sites in Texas for 13 months.

Format

A data frame with 369 rows (sites) and 43 columns:

Elevation

Elevation of the site.

Latitude

Latitude of the site.

Longitude

Longitude of the site.

Gulf

Gulf indicator for the site.

Max1, Max2, Max3, Max4, Max5, Max6, Max7, Max8, Max9, Max10, Max11, Max12, Max13

Maximum temperature for months 1 through 13.

Mean1, Mean2, Mean3, Mean4, Mean5, Mean6, Mean7, Mean8, Mean9, Mean10, Mean11, Mean12, Mean13

Mean temperature for months 1 through 13.

Min1, Min2, Min3, Min4, Min5, Min6, Min7, Min8, Min9, Min10, Min11, Min12, Min13

Minimum temperature for months 1 through 13.

Source

http://www.stat.ufl.edu/~winner/datasets.html
